mapper.select: SELECT binding.dept_id FROM sys_role_dept binding INNER JOIN sys_dept department ON department.id = binding.dept_id AND department.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND department.deleted = 0 AND department.status = 0 WHERE binding.role_id = #{roleId} AND binding.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND binding.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_dept (id, role_id, dept_id, tenant_id, deleted, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{deptId}, #{tenantId}, 0, #{operatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted = 0, delete_by = NULL, delete_time = NULL, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
